title: Your Wound Is Not Your Fault

scenes.narration: Your wound is not your fault, but your healing is your responsibility.
scenes.image_query: Your wound is not your fault, but your healing is your responsibility.

scenes.narration: No one can rewrite your past, but you can decide how your story continues.
scenes.image_query: No one can rewrite your past, but you can decide how your story continues.

scenes.narration: Heal, so the pain ends with you, not with the people you love.
